major_cooldowns.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it at 5 Soul Shards with 2 or more Demonic Core stacks banked and Dreadstalkers already out, then chain Hand of Gul'dan for the whole window since Tyrant gains 10% damage per active Wild Imp and Dreadstalker.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Doomguard
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open with it and send it on cooldown thereafter; every Demonic Core you consume cuts 3 sec off its cooldown, so it returns faster through heavy Demonbolt windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on cooldown at the top of the priority, ahead of Grimoire: Fel Ravager and Call Dreadstalkers, so its 20 sec of pet damage feeds the Tyrant setup.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Fel Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it immediately after Grimoire: Imp Lord and on cooldown thereafter; it also purges one beneficial magic effect from the target.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Siphon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it at 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks with at least 2 Wild Imps out to convert them into 2 stacks, and again after the second Hand of Gul'dan of the Tyrant window.

rule.description: Dreadstalkers, then Tyrant, then Hand of Gul'dan
rule.action: Build to 5 Soul Shards with Shadow Bolt, send Call Dreadstalkers, then Summon Demonic Tyrant, then pack the window with as many Hand of Gul'dan casts as you can.

rule.description: Summon Demonic Tyrant at 5 Soul Shards
rule.action: Enter the Tyrant window at 5 Soul Shards and at least 2 Demonic Core stacks so you can chain Hand of Gul'dan without pausing to generate.

rule.description: Call Dreadstalkers before Summon Demonic Tyrant
rule.action: Send Call Dreadstalkers in the two globals before Summon Demonic Tyrant; each active Wild Imp and Dreadstalker adds 10% to Tyrant damage.

rule.description: Demonbolt below the Soul Shard cap
rule.action: Demonbolt generates 2 Soul Shards, so only spend a Demonic Core on it below 4 shards; at 4 or 5 shards cast Hand of Gul'dan first.

rule.description: Demonbolt as the filler on Demonic Core
rule.action: With a Demonic Core banked and fewer than 4 Soul Shards, press Demonbolt instead of Shadow Bolt; it is instant, generates 2 shards and covers movement. Shadow Bolt is the filler only when no Core is up, and Infernal Bolt takes over at 2 or fewer shards.
Implode at 6 Wild Imps once 3 or more enemies are up, and give the imps a global to land first; single target it is only worth pressing with To Hell and Back.
